rendered: Among the cathodes listed, LFP (lithium iron phosphate) has the highest practical capacity in the review: it delivers a practical capacity of 170 mAh g[1] (mAh g⁻¹). LCO's practical capacity is lower, at typically only ≈140 mAh g[2] (mAh g⁻¹). LCO's theoretical capacity is much higher, at of 274 mAh g[3] (mAh g⁻¹), so its practical capacity is roughly half of its theoretical value. The review gives LNO only a theoretical figure (theoretical capacity ≈ 275 mAh g[4] (mAh g⁻¹)), with no practical capacity stated for LNO itself, so LFP's value is the highest practical capacity the review gives for these materials.
